description: This file defines a custom exception class `SavingsAccountCreditsBlockedException` used in the savings account module of the Fineract project. It signals that credit transactions are not allowed for a blocked savings account.

classes.name: SavingsAccountCreditsBlockedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that credit transactions on a specific savings account are blocked.

methods.name: SavingsAccountCreditsBlockedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific account ID and a predefined error message indicating that credits are not allowed.
